assertions.assertion: Recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with sick sinus syndrome
Requiring continuous rhythm monitoring to evaluate for bradyarrhythmias or pauses
Personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Mobile cardiac telemetry study indicated to assess for potential cardioembolic sources such as paroxysmal atrial fibrillation that may contribute to cerebrovascular risk
Service was medically necessary and consistent with the payer's coverage mandate for advance approval of this diagnostic procedure
